title: Morphological characteristics of corneal stromal stem cells and their age-related decline
task: Characterize corneal stromal stem cell morphology and age-related functional decline
key_results: SSC numbers and morphological characteristics decline with age (2 years); SCA-1+/CD90+ SSCs localize to anterior stroma with epithelial-like features suggesting mesenchymal-epithelial transition
comments: Spatial organization findings are descriptive but lack quantitative metrics for age-related decline or functional assays validating regenerative capacity loss.

hypotheses.hypothesis: SSCs exhibit mesenchymal-epithelial transition-like features within the limbal niche
hypotheses.result: A subset of SCA-1+/CD90+ cells displayed epithelial stem cell-like features and maintained contact with basal epithelium

hypotheses.hypothesis: Aging reduces regenerative capacity of the corneal limbus
hypotheses.result: Reduced SSC numbers and morphological alterations observed at 2 years of age

title: Metastatic promoting role of mesenchymal stem cells in oral squamous cell carcinoma revealed by an improved bone marrow chimeric model
task: Establish MSC role in oral squamous cell carcinoma progression and metastasis using improved bone marrow chimeric model
key_results: Lung metastasis occurred exclusively in MSC-rich mice; MSC-deficient tumors showed necrosis and immature MDSC infiltration; LepR inhibition paradoxically increased metastasis
comments: The improved BMC method better isolates MSC-specific effects, but the unexpected pro-metastatic outcome of LepR inhibition suggests MSC regulation is context-dependent and warrants mechanistic clarification.

model_io.model: GFP bone marrow chimeric mice with OSCC tumors
inputs: MSC abundance (varied by iBMC vs conventional transplantation)

hypotheses.hypothesis: MSC abundance directly promotes OSCC metastasis through enhanced vascularization and altered immunity
hypotheses.result: MSC-rich tumors showed enhanced vascularization, adaptive immune infiltration, and lung metastasis; MSC-deficient tumors exhibited necrosis

hypotheses.hypothesis: LepR signaling inhibition reduces MSC-mediated metastatic capacity
hypotheses.result: SHU9119-mediated LepR inhibition unexpectedly increased metastasis, revealing dual context-dependent MSC functions

title: Skeletal rearrangement in Biginelli reaction for the synthesis of chromenoquinoline fused spirohydantoins and their in silico cytotoxicity study
task: Synthesis and computational screening of chromenoquinoline-fused spirohydantoins for anticancer activity
key_results: Novel skeletal rearrangement yielding spirohydantoins with strong binding to kinesin Eg5 and 17 other tumor targets in molecular docking
comments: In silico docking results are promising but lack experimental cytotoxicity validation; biological evaluation is recommended before strong claims.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Spirohydantoins with chromenoquinoline scaffolds exhibit strong binding to kinesin Eg5 and tumor-associated targets
hypotheses.result: Molecular docking demonstrated strong binding efficiency against kinesin Eg5 and 17 other targets

title: A multi-modal deep learning framework for enhanced breast cancer diagnosis using mammograms and clinical data
task: Breast cancer diagnosis from multi-modal mammography and clinical data
comments: Clinical data were synthetic rather than real paired data, limiting clinical validation; architecture design is sound but proof-of-concept status warrants caution.

model_io.model: Multi-modal deep learning framework with hierarchical fusion and cross-modal attention

hypotheses.hypothesis: Integrating mammographic images with clinical data via hierarchical fusion and dynamic modality weighting improves diagnostic accuracy over single-modality baselines
hypotheses.result: Achieved 94.6% accuracy with AUC 0.963, significantly outperforming baseline models (p < 0.01)

title: Structure-aware 3D diffusion generation for kidney MRI via mask-guided noise scheduling and topology-prior constraints
task: Generate 3D kidney MRI images with structure-aware diffusion models
key_results: FID decreased from 18.74 to 11.16, KID from 7.983 to 4.573, PSNR increased from 26.214 to 28.577, LPIPS decreased from 13.442 to 5.7543
comments: Synthetic data effectively improves downstream segmentation in cross-domain transfer, validating practical utility; topology-prior constraints are complementary with noise scheduling.

model_io.model: Structure-aware 3D diffusion model with mask-guided noise scheduling and topology-prior constraints

inputs: synthetic MRI data (pre-training) or real MRI data (testing)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Organ-mask-guided adaptive noise scheduling slows degradation of critical kidney structures during diffusion
hypotheses.result: Structural improvements in FID, KID, PSNR, and LPIPS compared to baseline

hypotheses.hypothesis: Topology-prior constraints (distance fields, boundaries, skeleton) enhance connectivity and contour stability
hypotheses.result: Ablation studies show complementary gains; combined approach yields greater improvement than either constraint alone

hypotheses.hypothesis: Synthetic MRI data improves cross-domain robustness of downstream segmentation tasks
hypotheses.result: Pre-training on generated data effectively enhanced segmentation performance on real data

title: An effective two-stage key frame extraction method for speech-visual emotion recognition
task: Extract key frames from speech and visual modalities for emotion recognition
key_results: Two-stage method reduces redundancy and emotional information loss; demonstrates superior inference and generalization across RML, eNTERFACE05, MEAD, and BAUM-1s datasets
comments: Information entropy-based VKF extraction and silent-segment removal for SKFs are interpretable and effective; weighted fusion approach lacks detailed quantitative comparisons.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Information entropy modeling of emotion generation reduces visual frame redundancy in VKF extraction
hypotheses.result: First-stage VKF extraction effectively decreased redundancy and preserved emotional information

hypotheses.hypothesis: Aligning speech and visual key frames in stage two preserves complementary emotional information
hypotheses.result: Two-stage SVKF extraction demonstrated better inference and generalization than conventional methods on four benchmark datasets

title: Reliability and readability of five AI chatbots for concussion health advice across retrieval augmented and pretrained models
task: Evaluate reliability and readability of AI chatbots for concussion health advice
key_results: Perplexity Pro (RAG-based) achieved highest DISCERN (47.36 ± 4.84) and EQIP (65.00 ± 5.48) scores; all models exceeded 6th-grade reading level with transparency uniformly low
comments: RAG architectures improve clinical accuracy but readability and transparency remain problematic; human-in-the-loop verification is essential before clinical deployment.

model_io.model: Five AI chatbot platforms (ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity Pro, and others)
inputs: 11 high-volume concussion-related patient queries from Google Trends

outputs: readability indices (FRES, FKGL, GFI, CLI, ARI, SMOG)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) architectures provide more reliable and clinically accurate concussion advice than standard pre-trained LLMs
hypotheses.result: Perplexity Pro (RAG-based) significantly outperformed foundational models on DISCERN and EQIP (p < 0.01)

hypotheses.hypothesis: All models provide equally transparent and readable advice
hypotheses.result: Global quality scores did not differ (p = 0.373), but transparency was uniformly low; readability exceeded 10th-grade level in most models

title: Physics-informed Koopman learning approach for fixed-time synchronization of stochastic neural dynamics
task: Fixed-time synchronization of stochastic neuronal dynamics via physics-informed Koopman learning
key_results: Non-singular fixed-time controller guarantees pre-determined settling time independent of initial errors; dynamic event-triggering reduces communication bandwidth
comments: Physics-informed lifting dictionary is elegant, but numerical validation is limited; comparison against data-driven Koopman methods would strengthen claims.

model_io.model: Physics-informed Koopman operator with dynamic event-triggering mechanism
inputs: mixed Gaussian and Poisson jump noise

hypotheses.hypothesis: Physics-informed Koopman lifting with DETM achieves fixed-time synchronization under noise with reduced communication overhead
hypotheses.result: Confirmed via numerical simulations; convergence within pre-determined settling time achieved

title: Advanced security in fog environments using encryption and adaptive user activity tracking
task: Secure data storage and user activity tracking in fog computing
key_results: 43.39% faster encryption, 66% faster decryption, 19.86% higher throughput versus competing methods
comments: ASUT integrates AES-256, SHA-512, and UAT but lacks comparison against industry-standard fog security benchmarks; practical efficiency gains are incremental.

model_io.model: Adaptable User Activity Tracking (ASUT) with AES-256 and SHA-512

hypotheses.hypothesis: Integrating activity monitoring with strong encryption improves computational efficiency and unauthorized access mitigation
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; 43.39% faster encryption and 66% faster decryption achieved

title: Event-triggered mixed $$H_{\infty }$$ and passive control of networked switched systems subject to actuator failures
task: Event-triggered control of networked switched systems with actuator failures and delays
key_results: Sufficient criteria derived for exponential stability with prescribed weighted mixed H∞/passivity performance index
comments: Theoretical contribution via Lyapunov-Krasovskii functionals; numerical validation provided but no comparative benchmark against other event-triggered methods.

model_io.model: Event-triggered state-feedback switched control with mixed H∞/passivity

hypotheses.hypothesis: Event-triggered protocol with multiple Lyapunov functionals ensures exponential stability under mixed H∞ and passivity constraints
hypotheses.result: Proven; sufficient criteria derived, numerical example validates effectiveness
